# Build Day Log

This log covers the future physical Cerberus rebuild. Version 1 remains the existing Windows 10 dual-monitor baseline.

## Preparation

- [ ] Keep the motherboard in its anti-static bag and box until installation or bench testing.
- [ ] Retain the motherboard manual, Wi-Fi antenna, SATA cables, screws, bags, and all accessories.
- [ ] Inspect the socket, board, and connectors for damage before installation.
- [ ] Validate primary GPU, secondary GPU, and optional USB-card slot allocation.
- [ ] Prepare tools, ties, and installation media.
- [ ] Update the parts inventory without publishing serial numbers.
